policy.restore_requires: unique maintained authority, named owner, non-duplicative role, upgrade and publication route
policy.consolidate_requires: history retained; no second runtime or product authority
policy.historical_requires: immutable evidence/reproducibility status; no active release path
policy.new_hugging_face_spaces: forbidden_without_separate measured need; use existing flagship surfaces

post_restore_requirements: default branch protection or organization ruleset coverage
code scanning and dependency update coverage
backend health, readiness, source identity, and bounded failure semantics
mobile, keyboard, reduced-motion, high-contrast, and wide-screen frontend contracts
Hugging Face presentation through the declared existing flagship surface
no deployment or performance claim without provider readback
